description:
Two giant pandas on loan from the Chinese government landed in Atlanta Sunday to head to the city’s zoo. 

The pandas — a male named Ping Ping and a female named Fu Shuang — arrived on a FedEx flight from Chengdu, in southwestern China. Chinese leader Xi Jinping announced the rare loan on a state visit to Washington last week.
title: Two giant pandas arrive in Atlanta on rare loan from China

author: CNN
description:
Highlights from Farm Aid 2026: Music Festival Live, featuring live performances from Dave Matthews with Tim Reynolds, Neil Young with the Chrome Hearts and Willie Nelson & Family.

CNN returns as the exclusive broadcast partner for Farm Aid following a successful 2025 partnership, when CNN’s live broadcast of the festival’s 40th anniversary reached 3.88 million people globally and CNN audiences contributed more than $615,000 to Farm Aid.

Founded by Willie Nelson, Neil Young and John Mellencamp, this annual festival raises funds to support Farm Aid’s work with family farmers and inspires audiences to choose family farm food.

description:
A strong, early season nor’easter is delivering a prolonged stretch of wind and soaking rain to the Northeast, with conditions expected to worsen.

Meanwhile, heavy rain from Hurricane Nolo is ramping up in southern Hawaii, the islands’ third dangerous brush with a hurricane in just six weeks. Also, Hurricane Polo is battering Mexico and is expected to make landfall Monday on Baja California Sur.
